summary: HomeTube provides a web interface for downloading media from a wide range of supported websites directly into local Plex or Jellyfin directories. It handles tasks such as quality selection, subtitle retrieval, automated sponsor removal via SponsorBlock, and ongoing playlist synchronisation.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want an automated pipeline to ingest online video content directly into their existing media servers without manual intervention.
watchOut: The project relies on a large number of upstream site extractors which frequently break, requiring regular updates to maintain functionality.
deployNotes: As a containerised Python application, it typically requires persistent volume mounts for downloaded media and configuration data, alongside a reverse proxy for secure web access.
